effects.target: crude replicas of itself using various materials
constraints: the process has not been observed directly

evidence.locator: It is hypothesized that the subject is able to construct crude replicas of itself using various materials, by a process that has yet to be observed directly by Foundation staff.

constraints: a person is within 5 meters of SCP-1048-A

evidence.locator: Ear-like growths immediately began growing on those within 5 meters of the subject, covering their bodies in less than 20 seconds.

constraints: ear-like growths manifest in mouths and tracheae

evidence.locator: Autopsies revealed the cause of death to be asphyxiation caused by an abundance of the ear-like growths manifesting in the mouths and tracheae of all victims.
